name: Poster Paste
description: The second clip is pasted over the first as a poster, sheet after sheet: each wet sheet drops onto the wall hanging loose from its top edge with a soft shadow, then a brush smooths it on from top to bottom, leaving wrinkles and air bubbles that flatten out and seams that fade as the paste dries. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: sheets
params.description: Number of poster sheets pasted side by side, from left to right

params.name: wrinkles
params.description: How wrinkled, blistered and billowing the wet paper is before the brush smooths it flat
